changes.title: Outgoing Apple CEO Tim Cook discusses new U.S. manufacturing, job impact and more
changes.summary: Jo Ling Kent spoke exclusively with outgoing Apple CEO Tim Cook about a new manufacturing plant in Houston, what it means for jobs, and what he wants his legacy to be as he prepares to step down as CEO.
